blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday said the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) would review whether the visa-free entry arrangement for Chinese nationals was being exploited to facilitate illegal Philippine offshore gaming operator (Pogo) activities. This comes after authorities conducted separate raids on suspected illegal Pogo hubs in Zamboanga Sibugay and announced plans to deport 101 foreign nationals, including 82 Chinese nationals who allegedly entered and stayed in the country under the 14-day visa-free arrangement.
